map.📐 管路（壁厚）承压设计: Pipeline Design (Wall Thickness / Velocity / Pressure Drop)
map.按薄壁承压公式计算钢管计算壁厚、最小选用壁厚与标准规格取整（内径按 200 mm: Compute steel-pipe calculated wall thickness, minimum selected wall thickness and rounding to standard size by the thin-wall pressure formula (inner diameter taken as 200 mm).
map.计算壁厚 δ = 工作压力 × 内径 ÷ (2 × 许用应力)；最小选用壁厚 =: Calculated wall thickness δ = working pressure × inner diameter ÷ (2 × allowable stress); minimum selected wall thickness = δ + 1.5 mm allowance
map.薄壁圆筒承压公式 δ = pD/(2σ) 是压力管道壁厚设计的基础式；内径按 2: The thin-wall cylinder pressure formula δ = pD/(2σ) is the basis of pressure-pipe wall design; inner diameter is taken as 200 mm, an extra 1.5 mm covers corrosion allowance and negative deviation, then round up to the 0.5 mm standard size.
map.💡 计算壁厚 δ = 工作压力 × 内径 ÷ (2 × 许用应力)；最小选用壁厚: 💡 Calculated wall thickness δ = working pressure × inner diameter ÷ (2 × allowable stress); minimum selected wall thickness = δ + 1.5 mm; this tool takes inner diameter as 200 mm.
map.压力管道壁厚初选：按工作压力与材料: Initial pipe wall thickness: by working pressure and material
map.用薄壁圆筒公式 δ = pD/(2σ) 计算计算壁厚，加腐蚀余量后选取标准规格档: Use thin-wall cylinder formula δ = pD/(2σ) for calculated wall thickness, then add corrosion allowance and pick a standard size step.
map.材料替换比较：同一压力等级下比较不同许用应力材料所需壁厚，评估材料成本、焊接工艺: Material substitution comparison: compare required wall thickness of materials with different allowable stresses at the same pressure class, evaluate differences in material cost, welding process and construction difficulty.
map.既有管线校核：由实测壁厚与材料许用应力反推可承受的最高工作压力，判断提压或改输送: Existing pipeline check: back-calculate the maximum working pressure from measured wall thickness and material allowable stress, judge feasibility of raising pressure or changing conveyed medium.
map.算例：工作压力 1.6 MPa、许用应力 137 MPa（内径 200 mm）: Example: working pressure 1.6 MPa, allowable stress 137 MPa (inner diameter 200 mm)
map.计算壁厚 δ = 1.6 × 200 ÷ (2 × 137) = 1.168 m: Calculated wall thickness δ = 1.6 × 200 ÷ (2 × 137) = 1.168 mm; minimum selected wall thickness including 1.5 mm corrosion and deviation allowance = 2.67 mm; δ ÷ inner diameter = 0.00584 (far below the thin-wall limit 1/20); round up to 0.5 mm standard = 3.00 mm.
map.薄壁公式的适用范围是什么？: What is the thin-wall formula's applicable range?
map.δ/D ≤ 1/20 时薄壁圆筒假设成立（内径 200 mm 对应 δ ≤ 10: Thin-wall cylinder assumption holds when δ/D ≤ 1/20 (inner diameter 200 mm gives δ ≤ 10 mm); the 1.168 mm here is far within range; beyond this ratio use the Lame thick-wall formula.
map.1.5 mm 的附加量包含哪些内容？: What does the 1.5 mm allowance include?
map.覆盖腐蚀余量（通常 0.5–1.0 mm）、钢板厚度负偏差与加工减薄量，具体取值: Covers corrosion allowance (usually 0.5–1.0 mm), plate thickness negative deviation and forming thinning; the exact value should follow GB/T 20801 or the design document; corrosive media need a larger value.
map.钢管按规格档位供货（2.5、3.0、3.5 mm 等），计算值必须向上取整到可采: Steel pipes are supplied in size steps (2.5, 3.0, 3.5 mm, etc.); the computed value must round up to a purchasable step; rounding down would make actual pressure capacity insufficient.
map.按材料抗拉强度除以安全系数（一般 ≥3）与屈服强度除以 1.5，取两者中的较小值: Take the smaller of tensile strength divided by safety factor (generally ≥3) and yield strength divided by 1.5; at high temperature also multiply by a temperature correction factor.
